data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 5.7m (2021: GBP 120.9m) is a favourable development of GBP 20.5m (2021: deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.

prior_year_events.impact_description: December 2021 LPT ceded the majority of classes no longer written by Syndicates 4444 (2020 & prior years) and 1861 (2020 only); affected reinsurance recoverables and prior-year reported movements.

prior_year_events.event_name: Part VII transfer to Lloyd's Brussels
prior_year_events.impact_description: Transfer of EEA policies to Lloyd's Brussels on 30 Dec 2020 with subsequent 100% quota share reinsurance back; cash and reinsurance arrangements affected reporting and settlement accounts.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims reserves opened the year at GBP 391.956m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle for prior underwriting years shows a net adverse movement of approximately GBP 7.16m (1.83% of opening reserves), i.e. a gross strengthening of reserves. However, on a net basis the Syndicate reported a favourable development (net GBP 20.5m) driven by reinsurance arrangements (notably the December 2021 Loss Portfolio Transfer) and reinsurance recoveries, producing an overall favourable impact on reported net claims incurred. The movements reflect a mix of gross deterioration and material reinsurance activity and recoveries which together delivered a net improvement.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 5.7m (2021: GBP 120.9m) is a favourable development of GBP 20.5m (2021: deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.
The positive claims development during the year has resulted in a combined ratio for the run off Syndicate of 45.2% for 2022, compared to 98.6% in the prior year.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding GBP 391,956k). Prior-year development (gross) was not stated explicitly; computed from the gross claims development table (triangle) for 2019 and 2020 YOA yielding a net gross strengthening of ~GBP 7.156m. Note that the report also states a net favourable prior-year development of GBP 20.5m (net of reinsurance) reflecting significant reinsurance activity (LPT) and recoveries; RITC/LPT and reinsurance movements materially affect net vs gross outcomes. Gross triangle is limited to 2019 and 2020 columns only; RITC/LPT activity may distort comparisons. Where LOB-level prior-year movements are not provided, amounts are null and confidence low.
